author: Vior_
body: I was just kicked off the server for being kicked off the server too many times. Exactly 3 weeks. Most of the infractions are when my brother team spleefs of puts it in caps lock. I was wondering if I could shorten the temp ban.

title: Temp ban

replies.author: SirCyaniide
replies.body:
You are responsible for your account. You've  gotten 22 infractions regarding your immaturity. The guidelines state that you need 20 infractions to get a temp ban, but  leniency was on your side and you got it at 22 infractions.


In all you've received 22 warnings/chances to change your behavior on this server. I suggest you take the time to read the rules during your inactivity on this server
